egress.free_allowance: 100GB of outbound bandwidth per month for free; $0.04 per GB after that.

interface_detail: "TCP Proxy is available in the Koyeb control panel and the CLI and API."
tooling: Control panel, CLI, and API; enable TCP Proxy per service port.
chaining: Koyeb TCP proxy carries SSH to another host; with no UDP it cannot carry WireGuard.
binding_note: 100 GB/month is 0.091 TiB, an eleventh of the target. The proxy port itself is free and stable.

identity_cost.detail: One Free Instance per organization: 512MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 2GB SSD; signup by email.

reliability_note: Free Instance scales down to zero after 1 hour without traffic; TCP Proxy plus scale-to-zero "may lead to unexpected behavior".
confidence_note: UDP absence is stated by the product being named TCP Proxy; a probe would only restate it.

evidence.proved: "We provide 100GB of outbound bandwidth per month for free, usage after this allowance will cost $0.04 per GB."
Free Instance 512MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 2GB SSD, one per organization, scales down to zero after 1 hour without traffic
Proxy port persists across deployments unless disabled; "TCP Proxy is not compatible with Scale-to-Zero"

notes: Conflict worth naming: the Free Instance scales to zero after an hour idle, and the TCP Proxy is documented as incompatible with scale-to-zero. A free-tier TCP proxy is therefore expected to work only while something else keeps the service awake.

extras.wg_detail: TCP Proxy only: "TCP Proxy lets you expose the TCP ports of your Services to the Internet". No UDP is offered.
extras.volume_stated: 100GB of outbound bandwidth per month for free; $0.04 per GB after that.
extras.transit_note: Koyeb provisions a proxy host and port that forward to the service.
